name: A full disk refuses the switch
The switch holds the pin as base, not the head
replace: /\ base' = [base EXCEPT ![r] = [fmt |-> "old", items |-> world[r].items, shape |-> world[r].shape]]
/\ base' = [base EXCEPT ![r] = [fmt |-> "old", items |-> pin[r].items, shape |-> world[r].shape]]

name: Switch back installs base without the new format's changes
The release names only base
replace: ok == base[r] # NoRoot /\ Ref(base[r]) = op.base /\ Ref(built[r]) = op.built

name: A switch back keeps the build held
A malformed pin waits instead of refusing
A disk that fills partway refuses the switch
replace:
/\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![r] = "idle"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<log, cur, world, pin, prebuilt, buildHeld, base,
                 built, verdict, pending, full, crashes, stall, exp, faulted>>

\* The applied

/\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![r] = "idle"]
  /\ Done(r, "refused")
  /\ UNCHANGED <<log, world, pin, prebuilt, buildHeld, base,
                 built, pending, full, crashes, stall, exp, faulted>>

\* The applied

name: The retained root holds only the installed head's roots
A switch past the bound applies
The bound counts from the local prebuilt root
replace:
\/ Cardinality(Diff(pin[r].items, world[r].items)) > Bound
  \/ Cardinality(Diff(prebuilt[r].items, world[r].items)) > Bound

name: The switch uses a prebuilt root of a moved pin
A pending build holds replay up
A replica's replay grouping changes its root
replace: grouped == IF op.list /\ r = CHOOSE s \in Replicas : TRUE THEN
